observations.why: The statement presents a firm causal judgment, but it is not a performed decision or an enduring principle.
The completed shipment is presented as an actual past event involving a specific artifact.

A named integration is construed as an actual completed enabling event.

The quantified result is framed as a compact superlative performance beat, but it does not form a full triad; the evidence supports emphasis rather than a formal three-part structure.

payload.rationale: The document is a sprint retro covering three load-bearing concepts: (1) the async decision widget shipping — tied to Position_Sprint4ThesisProven and Obs_TanyaThesisProven which validate the product thesis, and to the broader Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning and its children (Position_AntiPatternRealtimeChat, Position_ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform, Position_TargetMarketRemoteTeams) that define the product category the widget embodies; (2) the Zephyr integration as key unlock — directly matched by Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock; (3) velocity at 23 points — matched by Obs_TinaVelocity and StyleObs_Sprint4_MetricAnchor which captures the numeric-anchoring style. StyleObs_Sprint4_DirectQuote captures the direct-quote format this document uses. Position_PricingTwelveDollars is included because the Sprint 4 retro context references a pricing update ($12 to $15) that this document's source retro touches. Sample_Sprint4Retro_20260322 is the prior sprint retro sample that grounds all these witnesses. No areas were deliberately excluded — the perspective is compact and every mapped area plausibly overlaps this document.
